plugin.name: path_locator
plugin.author: Ferdinand
plugin.purpose: find where a walk path starts using the map database
plugin.description:
Answers "where does this walk start?" using the mapper database.
* wherepath <directions> * wherepath nolib <directions> * wherepath reverse <directions>
Directions are space- or comma-separated: n s e w ne nw se sw u d tprt prtl
The reverse form inverts the path (reversed order, opposite directions) before searching: 'wherepath reverse w s s' searches 'n n e'. Teleports and portals have no inverse. Options combine in any order.
The mapper database is never written to (queries run under PRAGMA query_only).
Every room flagged both safe and library (the best guess for a recall room) is tried as a starting point; rooms from which the whole path can be walked are listed with their area, starting room and ending room. Paths whose ending room lies outside the starting room's area are discarded.
The nolib form drops the library requirement and tries every safe room.
Example:
wherepath ne n n n n w u
Also answers "what is the closest area to this room?":
* closestpath <room name>
Rooms matching the name (exact first, then substring) are used as starting points. Two answers are given:
1. A breadth-first search over recorded exits: the nearest rooms belonging to a different area, with the walked step count. 2. For starting rooms on the Alyria overworld, every recorded entrance from Alyria into another area ranked by grid distance (overworld uids encode map coordinates), which also covers areas the recorded walks never reach.
Example:
closestpath Snowy Fields of the Prowce Tundra

muclient.script:
-- same set as the mapper's is_valid_direction local DIRECTIONS = { n = true, s = true, e = true, w = true, ne = true, nw = true, se = true, sw = true, u = true, d = true, tprt = true, prtl = true, }
-- quote a string for SQL local function fixsql (s) return "'" .. string.gsub(s, "'", "''") .. "'" end
local function parse_path (text) local path = {} for token in string.gmatch(text or "", "[^%s,]+") do local dir = string.lower(token) if not DIRECTIONS[dir] then return nil, token end table.insert(path, dir) end return path end
local INVERSE_DIRECTION = { n = "s", s = "n", e = "w", w = "e", ne = "sw", sw = "ne", nw = "se", se = "nw", u = "d", d = "u", }
-- walk the path backwards, stepping opposite each direction local function invert_path (path) local inverted = {} for i = #path, 1, -1 do local dir = INVERSE_DIRECTION[path[i]] if not dir then return nil, path[i] end table.insert(inverted, dir) end return inverted end
local function walk (db, fromuid, path) local current = fromuid for _, dir in ipairs(path) do local touid for row in db:nrows(string.format( "SELECT touid FROM active_exits WHERE fromuid = %s AND dir = %s LIMIT 1", fixsql(current), fixsql(dir))) do touid = row.touid end if not touid then return nil end current = touid end return current end
local function end_room (db, uid) local room for row in db:nrows(string.format( "SELECT name, area FROM rooms WHERE uid = %s LIMIT 1", fixsql(uid))) do room = { name = row.name or uid, area = row.area } end return room -- nil when the room row is missing (stale touid) end
-- no CREATE: a missing file still fails to open (the shim has no flag constants) local SQLITE_OPEN_READWRITE = 2 local SQLITE_CANTOPEN = 14
local function active_exits_ready (db) local ready local ok, probe_err = pcall(function () for row in db:nrows( "SELECT value FROM mapper_meta WHERE key = 'active_exits_ready'") do ready = row.value end end) if not ok then return false, probe_err end return tostring(ready) == "1" end
local function open_mapper_db () local dbfile = GetInfo(66) .. "mm_mapper.db" -- READWRITE rather than READONLY: the database is WAL-journaled, and a -- read-only connection cannot recreate the -shm sidecar when the mapper -- is not holding the database open. query_only blocks writes instead. local db, code = sqlite3.open(dbfile, SQLITE_OPEN_READWRITE) if not db then if code == SQLITE_CANTOPEN then local legacy = io.open(GetInfo(66) .. Trim(WorldAddress()) .. "_mapper.db", "r") if legacy then legacy:close() return nil, "only a legacy mapper database exists; run 'mapper upgrade database' first" end return nil, "mapper database not found: " .. dbfile end return nil, string.format("cannot open mapper database (error %s): %s", tostring(code), dbfile) end db:exec("PRAGMA query_only = 1")
local ready, probe_err = active_exits_ready(db) if not ready then db:close() if probe_err then return nil, "cannot read the mapper database: " .. tostring(probe_err) end return nil, "the mapper's exit cache is not built; load the mapper plugin once, then retry" end return db end
local function find_starts (path, require_library) local db, err = open_mapper_db() if not db then return nil, err end
local where = " WHERE (',' || REPLACE(flags, ' ', '') || ',') LIKE '%,safe,%'" if require_library then where = where .. " AND (',' || REPLACE(flags, ' ', '') || ',') LIKE '%,library,%'" end
local matches = {} local ok, scan_err = pcall(function () for row in db:nrows( "SELECT uid, name, area FROM rooms" .. where .. " ORDER BY area, uid") do local enduid = walk(db, row.uid, path) if enduid then -- the ending room must be inside the starting room's area; a stale -- touid with no room row has no area, so it cannot qualify local endroom = end_room(db, enduid) if endroom and endroom.area == row.area then table.insert(matches, { area = row.area or "(no area)", startname = row.name or row.uid, startuid = row.uid, endname = endroom.name, enduid = enduid, }) end end end end) db:close() if not ok then return nil, "error while searching the mapper database: " .. tostring(scan_err) end return matches end
function wherepath (name, line, wildcards) local text = wildcards[1] or "" local require_library = true local reverse = false while true do local first, rest = string.match(text, "^%s*(%S+)%s*(.*)$") local lowered = first and string.lower(first) if lowered == "nolib" then require_library = false text = rest elseif lowered == "reverse" then reverse = true text = rest else break end end
local path, bad_token = parse_path(text) if bad_token then ColourNote("white", "maroon", string.format( "wherepath: '%s' is not a direction (use n s e w ne nw se sw u d tprt prtl)", bad_token)) return end if #path == 0 then ColourNote("silver", "black", "Usage: wherepath [nolib] [reverse] <directions> e.g. wherepath ne n n n n w u") return end
if reverse then local inverted, bad_dir = invert_path(path) if not inverted then ColourNote("white", "maroon", string.format( "wherepath: cannot reverse '%s' (teleports and portals have no inverse)", bad_dir)) return end path = inverted ColourNote("silver", "black", "wherepath: searching the inverse path: " .. table.concat(path, " ")) end
local matches, err = find_starts(path, require_library) if not matches then ColourNote("white", "maroon", "wherepath: " .. err) return end local label = require_library and "safe library room" or "safe room" if #matches == 0 then ColourNote("silver", "black", "wherepath: no " .. label .. " can walk that path.") return end
ColourNote("silver", "black", string.format( "wherepath: %d %s(s) can walk that path:", #matches, label)) for _, m in ipairs(matches) do ColourNote("white", "black", string.format("%s: %s (%s) -> %s (%s)", m.area, m.startname, m.startuid, m.endname, m.enduid)) end end
-- Alyria overworld uids encode grid coordinates: uid = y * 2300 + x -- (verified against active_exits: 'e' exits are +1, 's' exits are +2300) local GRID_W = 2300
local function grid_coords (uid) if not string.match(uid, "^%d+$") then return nil end local n = tonumber(uid) return math.floor(n / GRID_W), n % GRID_W end
-- breadth-first search outward from the source rooms through recorded -- exits; rooms belonging to an area other than the sources' own are -- recorded as hits and not expanded through local function bfs_nearest_areas (db, sources, home_areas) local MAX_VISITED = 50000 -- safety cap on well-mapped regions local MAX_AREAS = 10 local dist, frontier = {}, {} for _, uid in ipairs(sources) do dist[uid] = 0 table.insert(frontier, uid) end local hits, hit_count, visited, depth = {}, 0, #frontier, 0 while #frontier > 0 and visited < MAX_VISITED and hit_count < MAX_AREAS do depth = depth + 1 local nextf = {} for i = 1, #frontier, 200 do local chunk = {} for j = i, math.min(i + 199, #frontier) do table.insert(chunk, fixsql(frontier[j])) end for row in db:nrows( "SELECT ae.touid AS touid, r.name AS name, r.area AS area" .. " FROM active_exits ae LEFT JOIN rooms r ON r.uid = ae.touid" .. " WHERE ae.fromuid IN (" .. table.concat(chunk, ",") .. ")") do local v = row.touid if not dist[v] then dist[v] = depth visited = visited + 1 local area = row.area if area and area ~= "" and not home_areas[area] then if not hits[area] then hits[area] = { steps = depth, uid = v, name = row.name or v } hit_count = hit_count + 1 end else table.insert(nextf, v) end end end end frontier = nextf end return hits end
-- every recorded exit crossing from the Alyria overworld into another -- area, ranked by grid (Chebyshev) distance from the nearest source room local function geo_nearest_areas (db, source_coords) local best = {} for row in db:nrows( "SELECT ae.fromuid AS fromuid, r2.area AS area" .. " FROM active_exits ae" .. " JOIN rooms r1 ON r1.uid = ae.fromuid" .. " JOIN rooms r2 ON r2.uid = ae.touid" .. " WHERE r1.area = 'Alyria' AND r2.area IS NOT NULL" .. " AND r2.area <> '' AND r2.area <> 'Alyria'") do local y, x = grid_coords(row.fromuid) if y then local d for _, c in ipairs(source_coords) do local cd = math.max(math.abs(y - c.y), math.abs(x - c.x)) if not d or cd < d then d = cd end end local cur = best[row.area] if not cur or d < cur.dist then best[row.area] = { dist = d, y = y, x = x } end end end return best end
local function sorted_by_distance (map, key) local list = {} for area, info in pairs(map) do table.insert(list, { area = area, info = info }) end table.sort(list, function (a, b) if a.info[key] ~= b.info[key] then return a.info[key] < b.info[key] end return a.area < b.area end) return list end
function closestpath (name, line, wildcards) local text = Trim(wildcards[1] or "") if text == "" then ColourNote("silver", "black", "Usage: closestpath <room name> e.g. closestpath Snowy Fields of the Prowce Tundra") return end
local db, err = open_mapper_db() if not db then ColourNote("white", "maroon", "closestpath: " .. err) return end
local ok, run_err = pcall(function () -- exact name match first, substring match as a fallback local sources, source_coords, home_areas = {}, {}, {} local matched_exactly = true for row in db:nrows( "SELECT uid, area FROM rooms WHERE name = " .. fixsql(text) .. " COLLATE NOCASE LIMIT 50") do table.insert(sources, row.uid) home_areas[row.area or ""] = true if row.area == "Alyria" then local y, x = grid_coords(row.uid) if y then table.insert(source_coords, { y = y, x = x }) end end end if #sources == 0 then matched_exactly = false for row in db:nrows( "SELECT uid, area FROM rooms WHERE name LIKE " .. fixsql("%" .. text .. "%") .. " LIMIT 50") do table.insert(sources, row.uid) home_areas[row.area or ""] = true if row.area == "Alyria" then local y, x = grid_coords(row.uid) if y then table.insert(source_coords, { y = y, x = x }) end end end end if #sources == 0 then ColourNote("silver", "black", "closestpath: no room is named (or contains) '" .. text .. "'.") return end
ColourNote("silver", "black", string.format( "closestpath: searching from %d room(s) %s '%s'", #sources, matched_exactly and "named" or "matching", text))
local hits = bfs_nearest_areas(db, sources, home_areas) local walked = sorted_by_distance(hits, "steps") if #walked == 0 then ColourNote("silver", "black", "closestpath: no other area is reachable by recorded walks.") else ColourNote("silver", "black", "Nearest by recorded walk:") for _, w in ipairs(walked) do ColourNote("white", "black", string.format("%5d steps %s (enter at: %s [%s])", w.info.steps, w.area, w.info.name, w.info.uid)) end end
if #source_coords > 0 then local geo = sorted_by_distance(geo_nearest_areas(db, source_coords), "dist") if #geo > 0 then ColourNote("silver", "black", "Nearest overworld entrances by grid distance:") for i = 1, math.min(10, #geo) do ColourNote("white", "black", string.format("%5d rooms %s", geo[i].info.dist, geo[i].area)) end end end end) db:close() if not ok then ColourNote("white", "maroon", "closestpath: error while searching the mapper database: " .. tostring(run_err)) end end
